Schedule - Order nodes according to selected style, filling in the Sequence member.
VerifyScheduledSequence - Verify that all SUnits are scheduled and consistent with the Sequence of scheduled instructions.

briefdescription.para: EmitSchedule - Insert MachineInstrs into the MachineBasicBlock according to the order specified in Sequence.

detaileddescription.para: EmitSchedule - Emit the machine code in scheduled order.

Return the new InsertPos and MachineBasicBlock that contains this insertion point. ScheduleDAGSDNodes holds a BB pointer for convenience, but this does not necessarily refer to returned BB. The emitter may split blocks.

briefdescription.para: Returns a label for an SUnit node in a visualization of the ScheduleDAG.
isPassiveNode - Return true if the node is a non-scheduled leaf.
ForceUnitLatencies - Return true if all scheduling edges should be given a latency value of one.

detaileddescription.para: The default is to return false; schedulers may override this as needed.

briefdescription.para: ClusterNeighboringLoads - Cluster loads from "near" addresses into combined SUnits.

detaileddescription.para: ClusterNeighboringLoads - Force nearby loads together by "gluing" them.

This function finds loads of the same base and different offsets. If the offsets are not far apart (target specific), it add MVT::Glue inputs and outputs to ensure they are scheduled together and in order. This optimization may benefit some targets by improving cache locality.

briefdescription.para: ClusterNodes - Cluster certain nodes which should be scheduled together.
BuildSchedUnits, AddSchedEdges - Helper functions for BuildSchedGraph.
ScheduleDAGSDNodes - A ScheduleDAG for scheduling SDNode-based DAGs.

detaileddescription.para: Edges between SUnits are initially based on edges in the SelectionDAG, and additional edges can be added by the schedulers as heuristics. SDNodes such as Constants, Registers, and a few others that are not interesting to schedulers are not allocated SUnits.
SDNodes with MVT::Glue operands are grouped along with the flagged nodes into a single SUnit so that they are scheduled together.
SDNode-based scheduling graphs do not use SDep::Anti or SDep::Output edges. Physical register dependence information is not carried in the DAG and must be handled explicitly by schedulers.
